component-o.description-s: TPS6303x 1.8-5.5 V input buck-boost converter, fixed 3.3 V output, 1-A switches, 2.4 MHz, 2.5 x 2.5 mm VSON-10 (DSK)

cfgpins-ao.10c: fixed 3.3 V version: FB must be connected directly to VOUT (Pin Functions p3, 9.2.2.1 p11)

cfgpins-ao.6c: EN tied to VINA, always on (Figure 6 p10)

cfgpins-ao.7c: PS/SYNC tied to VINA: power save disabled (1 = disabled, p3; Figure 6 p10)

cfgpins-ao.4c: L1 1.5 uH between L1 and L2 (Table 2 p11: Coilcraft LPS3015-1R5); C1 10 uF on VIN, C2 2 x 10 uF on VOUT, C3 0.1 uF on VINA (Figure 6 p10, Table 2 p11)

specs-o.vout_accuracy-s: 3.267 / 3.3 / 3.333 V with PS/SYNC = VIN; -3 % / +6 % referenced to 3.3 V with PS/SYNC = GND (power save)

vout_source-o.table-s: 7.5 Electrical Characteristics, DC/DC STAGE: VFB row 'TPS63031 output voltage' 3.267 / 3.3 / 3.333 V (PS/SYNC = VIN)

iout_source-o.table-s: Features: 800 mA output current at 3.3 V in step-down mode (VIN 3.6 - 5.5 V); up to 500 mA at 3.3 V in boost mode (VIN > 2.4 V); Description: up to 600 mA from a single Li-ion cell

fsw_source-o.table-s: 7.5 Electrical Characteristics: f oscillator 2200 / 2400 / 2600 kHz; ISW average switch current limit 900 / 1000 / 1300 mA (VIN = VINA = 3.6 V, 25 C); high-side and low-side switch on-resistance 200 mOhm typ; Iq into VIN+VINA 25 typ / 35 max uA, into VOUT 4 / 6 uA; shutdown 0.1 / 0.9 uA; UVLO (VINA falling) 1.4 / 1.5 / 1.6 V

specs-o.cap_notes-s: p12: input >= 4.7 uF ceramic recommended; VINA bypass 0.1 uF, not above 0.22 uF; output nominal 10 uF recommended, no upper limit

not_stated-o.vref_mv: not applicable / not stated as a reference: TPS63031 is the fixed 3.3 V version with an internal divider (FB tied to VOUT); the 500 mV VFB (495/505) in the same table belongs to the adjustable TPS63030 -- use vout_fixed_mv
not_stated-o.loop_crossover_khz: not stated in tps63030.pdf (30 pages; no loop / bode / crossover data)
not_stated-o.output_impedance_mohm: not stated; only 'maximum load regulation 0.5 %' (typ column, p5) without a current span
not_stated-o.footprint: MISMATCH: the board footprint is Texas_DRC0010J (3 x 3 mm VSON-10, pads at x = +/-1.4 mm); tps63030.pdf documents TPS6303x only in the 2.5 x 2.5 mm DSK package (p1, p3 Table 1, p19 packaging). Same pin numbering as the DRC-package TPS63000/1/2 (see TPS63001DRCR)

sw_not_stated-o.sw_rise_ns: not stated in tps63030.pdf: no switch rise-time row in its tables (27 pages)
sw_not_stated-o.sw_fall_ns: not stated in tps63030.pdf: no switch fall-time row in its tables (27 pages)
sw_not_stated-o.sw_coss_pf: not stated in tps63030.pdf: no switch-pin or C_oss capacitance row in its tables (27 pages)
